title: Node is single threaded
body: There is one thread running my JavaScript. Slow stuff like reading files gets handed off, and the callback runs later when it's done.

title: require caches modules
body: A module's code only runs the first time. After that require() gives back the same exports object.

title: Streams vs readFile
body: readFile loads the whole file into memory. createReadStream sends it in chunks, so a big file doesn't blow up memory.
